# Fractal Infinity

Fractal Infinity is a California-born, U.S.-made frontier-technology research and consulting practice. The canonical public site is https://fractalinfinity.io.

## Public services
- Brand, market, and platform ecosystem design
- Data creation and knowledge graph design
- LLM workflows and AI assistance
- Emerging-network and ASI-readiness planning
- Difficult technical, product, and personal-AI problem solving

## Human engagement
Consulting is human-assisted and begins by email. It is not an autonomous API or a self-service agent endpoint.

- Contact: fractalinfinityfuture@gmail.com
- Contact page: https://fractalinfinity.io/contact.html
- Rates: $250/hour signal call; $400/hour build session; $650/hour embedded partner

## Process Intelligence (product direction)
- Live: Fractal Research MCP v0.1 recorder (local/private alpha) → swarmresearch-run-v1 → /report/{run}
- Coming next: SDK wrapper, GitHub Action
- Later: Adaptive Research auto-investigator (opt-in)
Fractal is a layer on existing agent workflows, not a place to paste prompts. Focus: independence, evidence lineage, consensus, novelty, duplication, unresolved uncertainty.
